narrative: On the board. The last leaf, looked at again at home. A signature at the foot. No word of the play is struck through. The three older leaves are not on the board.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and left both plays as the morning had left them.

entities.name: the lovers' play
